I know everyone's focused on Nancy Pelosi copytraders sending $BE up 11.83%. Or Trump... 

But you know what else is cool? 

FAU bottlenecks for CPO. 

I remember saying earlier this year FAU/Foci might be a future bottleneck around $TSM / $NVDA CPO roadmaps... 

This was some media commentary supporting that: 

"It is understood that Largan Precision (3008), FOCI (3363), and China’s TFC have entered $NVDA FAU supply chain"

"Based on an estimated 20,000 Spectrum-X systems shipped this year, the optical engines installed in those systems would require approximately 600k-700k FAUs" 

In 2027, demand is expected to reach several million units, and existing supply chain capacity is currently unable to meet demand." (UDN, mandarin -> english translation is kinda off)

Cough cough, "existing supply chain capacity is currently unable to meet demand"

Tad early right now since mass production is expected H2 2027, but cool to read updates around this.

tweets.text:
a bull case for Ethereum and ETH which we have not seen in the past several cycles:

the "alt-L1 ETH-killer" argument has now been rendered mostly moot

there will ofc likely be a few L1s which matter longterm, so i'm not saying nothing else will be relevant

but most of this cycle's NEW token darlings are all relatively niche apps by comparison

not real L1s which have a path for extremely high value global settlement, or even a lot of general use cases beyond their app domains

meanwhile, Ethereum is rapidly scaling and has a new R&D fire lit under its ass with (unintentional) EF obstructionism now mostly gone with a constellation of great Ethereum orgs focused on helping it win

openrouter usage of chinese models specifically is through the roof.

tweets.text:
if hugging face does get acquired for $13 billion this is a bigger deal than stripe buying openrouter

- hugging face currently has ~3 million models accessible on their platform (openrouter has 400)

- their moat is all the open model derivatives that independent developers have created. qwen models alone have 155,000.

- 1 million+ datasets (including private enterprise repos)

- the same inference routing design openrouter has. 

currently anyone can go to HF, find a unique model, download the weights or run it directly on platform through a single api.

that is an incredibly lucrative opportunity.
